findings.text: follow-on: the failure-reporting assertion compares selection['authority_error'] against the same literal 'CrewError: mounts unavailable' the test passed in as the authority_error argument, the two-sides-move-together shape the review prompt names; it catches only a dropped key and cannot detect the reason being altered or a real resolution failure being misreported, so reporting is not independently verified end to end.

follow-on: the candidate block now renders the harness-independent node_tokens while the context-fit window gate still keys its allowed/refusal on the per-backend estimate (reckon/crew/routing.py:3587-3590 sums standing_tokens from that backend's backend_settings), so on a lane whose standing chain exceeds the request's the block's headroom_pct overstates free window space; the gate refusal is preserved but Jev's headroom reading is no longer the figure the gate used.

item_verdicts.diff: read the three commits against their bases; item 1 edits reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py and reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, item 2 edits reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, beside the two test files and the evidence fragment and figure, and the branch merged origin/main at 1f171edfd between the two items.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names two clauses proved by tests; item 1's 'reported' clause is asserted at tests/test_pick_paths_carry_authority.py:198 and driven through both paths at :116 and :160, and item 2's equality is asserted at tests/test_pick_paths_carry_authority.py:234; item 1's 'charged once' clause is not asserted by any test.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to carry the dispatch authority on every pick path and use one backend-settings rule for the request estimate and the candidate blocks; reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:105 resolves the authority for the dry-run and shadow paths and reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:234 renders one figure in every candidate block.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, base 66ad94b2, head d6e79cf3, three commits, baseline_suite and after_suite carrying the two gate logs (74 and 79 passed, exit 0), and it self-declares the tests/test_jev_weighs_context.py deviation.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the seven paths fenced in the run manifest's orientation_write_paths contain every path the diff touches, though the manifest itself flags tests/test_jev_weighs_context.py as a deviation from the plan section's narrower write-path list.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log and negative-control-2.log each redden one named test (EXIT=1), but the failure-reporting assertion at tests/test_pick_paths_carry_authority.py:222 compares the selection against the literal the test itself passed in, so it can only catch a dropped key.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log and gate-head.log record 74 and 79 passed at exit 0 with zero added failures, but the done-when's 'charged once' clause has no asserting test and 'reported' rests partly on the assertion at tests/test_pick_paths_carry_authority.py:222.
justifications.fit: resolve_picker_authority and authority_error are named for the mechanism and follow the existing guarded-resolution idiom in reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:105.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both done-when items are implemented - reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:105 resolves the authority for the two paths the section names and reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:234 unifies the figure.
justifications.reuse: resolve_picker_authority wraps the existing resolve_dispatch_authority (reckon/crew/routing.py:2901) rather than re-implementing it, and _context_block deletes the per-backend branch rather than adding a second rule.
justifications.scope_discipline: every diff path is inside the run manifest's fenced write paths, but the plan section's write-path list names neither reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py nor tests/test_jev_weighs_context.py, which the manifest itself flags.
